data.name: Emara
data.gender_notes: Emara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Emara means ‘rider’ or ‘traveler’. This name is derived from the root letters ‘A-M-R’, which convey the concept of ‘to command’. In Islamic history, Emara is the name of a noblewoman who was a strong and righteous leader, inspiring her people to follow the path of truth. The name Emara carries the meaning “Rider, Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Emara usually hope their child will grow to embody rider, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of courage and leadership on life's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Emara belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rider, Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emara total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
